games.name: [🎉 50M] Admin House!
games.desc:
A classic edition of Admin House where you must complete an obstacle course to unlock admin so that you can build, listen to music, and more! 
You can save commands and builds (see :cmdbox and F3X :btools for the options). F3X building tools are mobile-compatible and feature multi-selecting parts (use the bottom right-hand corner button on mobile). 

[Version v3.5.7]:
View full changelog by running :updatelogs ingame

To save a build, select all the items you want to save in F3X (see multi-select for mobile above). Then, press the save button. As of 6/27/2024, decals and skybox have been re-enabled in public servers. 

Say ":cmds" for a list of commands. 
Say "!rules" to view the game's rules.

Send me a PM if you run into any bugs/suggestions (or join the server below and report them there). The server link below has been updated (as of April 02, 2025)
